description: MHFE-REPAIR-1. repair_words maps k = 2, 4, 6 and 8 to the k repair words of the container phrase. Each repair uses the k repair words of its case; positions count from 1, unreadable positions are erasures, replaced gives a wrong word at a position, and restored gives the original word at every repaired position. The cases are the rows of the table in README.md of this folder.
